title: Pure-Python stdlib toolkit XL: twelve stdlib module clones (tomllib, shlex, re, csv, ipaddress, fractions, urllib.parse, base64, difflib, textwrap, json, calendar) graded differentially
sdk_test_cmd: python3 tests/run_public.py $(git diff --name-only $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) -- toolkit | sed -n 's#^toolkit/\(.*\)\.py$#\1#p' | sed -e 's/^shellsplit$/shlex/' -e 's/^tomlparse$/toml/' -e 's/^csvx$/csv/' -e '/^__init__$/d')
